character_sheets.su_wan: Chinese woman, 28 years old, shoulder-length straight black hair parted on the side, thin sharp eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with dark irises, pale fair skin with cool undertone, slender 170cm frame, long legs. Signature outfit: tight black knee-length pencil skirt prominently shaping hips and thighs, sheer black seamed stockings clearly visible, strappy black high heels. Red lipstick, minimal makeup.
character_sheets.lin_ze: Chinese man, mid 30s, short slightly unruly black hair, visible stubble, tired dark-circled eyes, square jaw, lean athletic build, rumpled off-white dress shirt with loosened charcoal tie, dark trousers, exhausted insomniac demeanor.

shots.image_prompt:
Shot on 35mm slight overexpose on whites, grain texture on shadow. 50mm natural prime feel, shallow DoF. Cool white bathroom fluorescent overhead vs warm amber vanity lamp creating split-tone lighting. Steam and condensation on mirror surface. Desaturated palette except burgundy accent. Old-city Chinese apartment bathroom at 2AM. Nan Goldin intimacy crossed with Saul Leiter compositional looseness. Photorealistic.

Candid documentary still, not staged. Present-continuous verbs. Specific physical tells only: half-raised brow, pressed lips, dilated pupils, corner-of-eye glance, jaw tension, lower lip pressing inward, nostril flare, chin drop, Adam's apple swallowing once, knuckles whitening, slow blink hold. Never use interpretive emotion words like composed, mysterious, sensual, seductive, predatory, amused, alluring. Body language: weight shift, hands mid-gesture, gaze directed at an object or middle distance. All mouths stay closed; lips sealed; no teeth; no mouth interior. Shot Design: one shot does one thing.

VERTICAL 2:3 BATHROOM MIRROR SHOT.

Characters in frame:
- Su Wan, 28-year-old Chinese woman: seen via bathroom mirror reflection, shoulder-length straight black hair parted on the side, thin sharp eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes, pale fair skin with cool undertone. Signature red lipstick. Her real body at frame right edge, reflection dominant left 65% of frame.

MOTIFS—Tier 2 (scene-level for bathroom):
- white ceramic tile walls, bare bulb above sink, round bathroom mirror with slight steam condensation at lower edge
- Chinese megacity neon skyline through rain-streaked window, coffee table with USB and documents just visible in doorway background blur
- burnt-ochre velvet or similar warm furniture silhouette in doorway bokeh

MOTIFS—Tier 3 (shot-level):
- Su Wan seen via bathroom mirror reflection
- waterproof plastic bag visible being retrieved from behind mirror frame, hands mid-extraction gesture
- steam or condensation on mirror edge creating soft diffusion at frame bottom
- cool fluorescent overhead bathroom light (5600K daylight) vs warm amber vanity lamp (2700K tungsten) creating split-tone on her face: cool side near overhead, warm side near vanity
- white ceramic tile background visible around mirror edges

LAYERED GARMENT VISIBILITY—NOT TRIGGERED AT THIS CROP.
Face-level shot does not show thigh or stocking band. Layer 10 rule does not apply here.

ACTION MOMENT—Mirror Extraction, 100–120 words:
Mid-moment: Su Wan's hands are mid-extraction, fingers curled around waterproof bag edge, pulling it down and forward from behind mirror. Her face in mirror reflection shows corner-of-eye glance directed at the bag's emergence—not at camera, not at Lin Ze (off-frame). Slight tension visible in jaw line. Breath sway implied by subtle shoulder shift. The fluorescent light flattens her cheekbones; the vanity lamp creates amber edge-light on the right side of her face where it turns away from camera. Condensation beads on mirror frame edge in foreground, slightly out of focus, creating soft boundary. Captured as if shot by Nan Goldin for mirror-subject intimacy—the revelation of private action behind the reflective surface that normally hides identity. 35mm grain texture in shadow areas (lower left frame where tile meets darkness) adds documentary texture. No visible teeth. Lips sealed. Hair falls naturally across left shoulder as she bends slightly forward mid-extraction. The bag emerges slow-motion-quality, present-continuous.
shots.director_note: Vertical 2:3 for mirror shot—the reflection composition naturally takes vertical space. Su Wan's real face at frame right edge, reflection dominant left. Layer 10: no stocking visible at this crop (face-level). use_anchor=true for Su Wan face identity lock. Style preamble switches to act2_intimate_morning (NOT noir).

SQUARE 1:1 INSERT SHOT—OBJECT ISOLATION.

Characters in frame:
- Su Wan hand only: Chinese woman's hand, pale fair skin with cool undertone, slender fingers, burgundy-red glossy toenail polish visible on one fingertip where hand partially visible at edge of frame. No face. Hand only with wrist visible at bottom frame edge.

MOTIFS—Tier 2 (scene-level for bathroom):
- white ceramic tile floor, cool bathroom fluorescent light bleaching whites to near-white with minimal shadow
- worn concrete/tile grout lines visible as geometric frame

MOTIFS—Tier 3 (shot-level):
- USB drive (black rectangular, approximately 3cm long) lying flat on white tile floor, center-frame
- Su Wan's hand positioned above drive, thumb and two fingers visible grasping or about to grasp the drive
- waterproof document pouch, white plastic, partially open, bottom-right frame edge—interior documents just visible but not readable
- burgundy-red glossy nail polish on Su Wan's fingertips creating warm accent point against cool white tile
- cool bathroom fluorescent light casting minimal shadow, creating flat clinical illumination on tile surface

LAYERED GARMENT VISIBILITY—NOT TRIGGERED.
Insert shot shows hand and USB only. No garment elements visible. Layer 10 rule does not apply.

ACTION MOMENT—USB Retrieval, 110–130 words:
Mid-moment: Su Wan's hand is mid-grasp, thumb and index finger converging toward USB drive lying on white tile. The drive sits flat, stable, slightly reflective. Her fingertips with burgundy nail polish create color accent against the cool white environment. Wrist visible at frame bottom shows slight tension—not gripping yet, but poised. The waterproof pouch edge visible at bottom-right frame shows interior edge of documents, suggesting weight and consequence inside. Cool fluorescent light from overhead creates minimal shadow under her hand—the shadow line barely visible, defining her knuckles with anatomical clarity. The tile grout lines frame the drive as if in a grid. No face in frame. No emotional interpretation—just the physical geometry of hand, drive, pouch, tile, light. Captured as if shot by Saul Leiter for object-and-hand documentary tension. The burgundy nail echoes act1_start_02 (interrogation room foot shot), creating visual motif Motif A across the two nodes: same color, different context, different agency (observed vulnerability → active instrumentality). 35mm grain barely visible at this exposure level but present in tile texture.
shots.director_note: Pure object insert. Su Wan partial sheet: hand only with burgundy nails. The burgundy nail color echoes act1_start_02—same motif, different context (feet → hands). This is the cross-node echo: Motif A. Aspect ratio 1:1 isolates the drive and hand from spatial context, maximizing object focus.

VERTICAL 2:3 BODY FRAGMENT SHOT—SHADOW-CAST LEGS.

Characters in frame:
- Su Wan leg only: shadow of stockinged legs cast on white bathroom ceramic tile floor. The shadow is the character presence—not the body itself visible, only its dark silhouette projection.

MOTIFS—Tier 2 (scene-level for bathroom):
- white ceramic tile floor surface, clean, grout lines visible as geometric grid
- warm amber lamp light source grazing horizontally from lower-left frame, creating raking illumination
- cool overhead fluorescent as secondary fill (visible only in non-shadowed tile areas)

MOTIFS—Tier 3 (shot-level):
- shadow of tight black knee-length pencil skirt hem line as sharp horizontal cut line at top of frame
- 2-3 centimeter visible skin gap shadow between skirt hem shadow and stocking-top-band shadow
- shadow of stocking top band at upper thigh, lace or silicone grip edge clearly cast (approximately 5cm width shadow band)
- sheer black nylon stocking shadow body translucent appearance: shadow shows texture variation where nylon mesh translucency allows warm lamp light to glow through, creating lighter areas within the dark shadow where skin tone luminosity reads through the sheer material
- back seam line shadow running vertical from stocking top band downward through calf shadow, creating asymmetrical shadow detail
- warm amber lamp light from below creating raking highlight along the outer edge of the shadow (approximately 0.5–1cm bright rim around shadow perimeter where light grazes the tile surface)
- tile grout lines visible as geometric contrast to organic shadow shape
- shadow angle suggests subject standing with slight weight shift, one leg bearing more weight than other

LAYERED GARMENT VISIBILITY—MANDATORY RULE 10 ACTIVATION.
This shot is flagged as Class D high-risk. Layered Garment Rule mandatory:
1. Skirt hem line explicit in shadow—sharp horizontal cut line visible at frame top
2. 2–3cm bare skin gap shadow between skirt hem and stocking-top-band—clearly differentiated shadow tone
3. Stocking top band at UPPER thigh with visible lace/silicone grip texture in shadow—band width approximately 5cm, lace texture cast as fine detail
4. Sheer nylon body translucent with skin tone glowing through mesh—shadow shows internal luminosity variation where amber lamp light transmits through transparent nylon and reflects off skin beneath
5. Back seam line shadow tracing vertical down leg—seam visible as asymmetrical shadow detail running from band to ankle

HARD NEGATIVES—Mandatory exclusions:
- NOT pants (pants would show different fabric weight and drape in shadow)
- NOT over-the-knee socks (over-the-knee implies shorter garment, shadow band would stop mid-calf)
- NOT knee-highs (knee-high shadow band position would be at knee, not at upper thigh)
- NOT tights (tights would show uniform nylon weight without distinct top band lace texture)

Subject is wearing thigh-high stockings, not other hosiery.

ACTION MOMENT—Shadow Projection on Tile, 120–140 words:
Mid-moment: Su Wan's body is standing, weight shifted onto right leg (right shadow darker, bearing more load), left leg slightly relaxed. The shadow cast by warm amber lamp light from below creates definition of her standing posture without showing her body—only the projected silhouette. The skirt hem casts sharp horizontal line at top of frame (approximately 5cm down from top). Below hem, 2–3cm of clear shadow gap where upper thigh skin is exposed and illuminated (the gap reads as slightly brighter within the overall dark shadow area because bare skin reflects more light than fabric). Below the gap, the stocking-top-band casts as distinct shadow band approximately 5cm wide, with visible lace or silicone grip texture rendered as fine shadow detail. The nylon stocking body below the band shows translucency effect: the raking amber lamp light from below penetrates the sheer nylon, illuminating skin underneath, creating internal glow variation within the dark stocking shadow (lighter patches where light transmits through mesh and reflects off skin). The back seam line runs as asymmetrical shadow line from band downward through calf, creating anatomical specificity. Warm amber rim light traces outer edge of shadow where lamp light grazes tile directly. Tile grout lines frame the shadow composition. Captured as if shot by Saul Leiter for color-and-light documentary detail. This shot echoes act1_start_02 (interrogation room foot shot) as cross-node Motif A continuation—same body part motif (legs/feet), different lighting environment (warm amber vanity lamp in bathroom vs interrogation room amber), different emotional register (escape moment vs observation moment). 35mm grain visible in tile texture.

WIDE 16:9 REACTION CU—BATHROOM COLD LIGHT.

Characters in frame:
- Lin Ze face only: Chinese man, mid 30s, short slightly unruly black hair, visible stubble on jaw and chin, tired dark-circled eyes with dark irises, square jaw, lean athletic build suggested by neck/shoulder at frame bottom. Exhausted insomniac demeanor visible in eye bags and slack facial resting state. Rumpled off-white dress shirt with loosened charcoal tie visible at frame bottom edge (approximately 15% of frame).

MOTIFS—Tier 2 (scene-level for bathroom):
- white ceramic tile background (approximately 60% of frame behind Lin Ze head, creating clean clinical backdrop)
- bathroom fluorescent light casting clinical cold 5600K daylight color temperature on his face (no warm amber here—the fluorescent is the dominant key light in this moment)

MOTIFS—Tier 3 (shot-level):
- Lin Ze's jaw tension held visible in jaw line definition and muscle tension visible at angle of jaw
- gaze directed downward at documents in his hands (off-frame bottom), not at Su Wan, not at camera
- bathroom fluorescent light casting cold clinical blue-white tone across his face, creating strong cheekbone definition and shadow under jaw
- white tile background reflects cool light onto his face, eliminating warm amber vanity lamp influence at this camera angle
- dark hair shadow on forehead from overhead bathroom light
- eye bags and tired expression visible in slack under-eye area and lower eyelid weight
- mouth closed, lips sealed, no tension around mouth—just neutral resting position

LAYERED GARMENT VISIBILITY—NOT TRIGGERED.
Face-level shot shows no garment detail. Layer 10 rule does not apply.

ACTION MOMENT—Documents in Hands, 130–150 words:
Mid-moment: Lin Ze's face is angled downward, eyes scanning documents in his hands (visible at frame bottom as rumpled paper edges in off-white and beige tones, slightly out of focus). His jaw is set with tension—not clenched, but held taut, showing definition in the jaw line and masseter muscle visible under cool bathroom fluorescent light. The fluorescent creates strong shadow under his jaw and under his cheekbones, reading as cold clinical light (not the warm amber of interrogation room). The white tile background behind him is evenly lit, creating clean backdrop that emphasizes face isolation. His eye gaze is directed down at the documents, present-continuous scanning motion, not looking up at Su Wan or camera. The dark under-eye bags visible in the cool light read as exhaustion and sleeplessness. His hair falls naturally across forehead, casting light shadow. The rumpled off-white shirt at frame bottom shows creases in fabric consistent with several hours of wearing. One Adam's apple swallow visible as subtle motion—the throat tightens once, releasing once. The mouth stays closed, lips sealed, resting neutral. No tongue visible. No emotional interpretation—just the physical geometry of jaw tension, downward gaze, eye fatigue, fluorescent light on face. Captured as if shot by Saul Leiter for cold-light documentary intensity. The style preamble shift from act1_noir_interrogation to act2_intimate_morning means this fluorescent-only lighting is now the dominant visual key: he has no warm amber interrogation light to hide behind anymore. This is the visual signal that the story has moved beyond institutional space into private consequence. The clinical cold light literalizes the turning point: 'he is already without a way out.' Cover candidate for branchA2_scene1.
